origin.description: Alias of checkInt. Returns true, or a message, after testing whether the value is a single integerish number.
origin.usage: check_int(x, na.ok = FALSE, lower = -Inf, upper = Inf, tol = sqrt(.Machine$double.eps), null.ok = FALSE)

arguments.name: x
